svg.title: Personal AI OS — session handoff loop
svg.desc: The session-handoff capability closes a substantive working session and reopens it cold. Closing: sweep the change journal, checkpoint the work, validate, then record an honest stopping point where the next session will look first — what was done with evidence, open items in order, anything left broken. Resuming: read the record before acting, re-verify its claims against live state with scripts, and restate the stopping point to the human before writing. Trivial question-and-answer sessions produce no record.
svg.text: session-handoff — end a session so any session can resume it cold

g.text: every medium+ change has its line
uncommitted work does not exist yet
## Resume in the note · or the user's own form
the record is canonical over recollection
Read the record first, re-verify its claims
counts from scripts, never from recall
Restate the frame, then continue the work

svg.text: Floors at every depth: journal · checkpoint · honest stopping point. The form is the user's (80 User/handoff.md, method packs).
